_about: Frameflow config for the shorts-writer skill (~/Talha_Khan/Claude/skills/shorts-writer).
house_rules: Indian English for an Indian audience aged 18-30: curious, online, not necessarily developers
Mostly informative: 3-5 light comic beats (analogies, absurd-but-true comparisons), never jokes about victims or the facts themselves
Explain any technical word in the same breath with an everyday comparison (what PHP is, what 'run code on a server' means)
No fear-mongering: big numbers are attempts or exposure unless the brief says they are confirmed harm
Never say 'in this video', never greet, never end on 'follow for more' or 'thanks for watching'
Brand names are said plainly (Wikipedia, Cloudflare); no slogans or praise of companies
Spell numbers for the voice (twenty twelve, thirty-four million); digits are for the screen only
